notes.title: The transfer site maintenance has been finished
notes.content:
Greetings, Wolves!
Thank you for your patience.

We have fixed the issue, and now you can submit the transfer form! :D

I bring some tips for helping your transfer.
I hope this helps you well. XD


The below information will be transferred.

- Rank (Exp)
- Characters
- Weapons
- Items
- And so on


The below information will not be transferred.

- Gold
- WC
- Cash
- Pride


How can I transfer my account?
Step-by-Step Instruction

Don't add Wolfteam: Reboot on your Steam library before you submit the transfer form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/8c12310a836382e6dac3c30a78f2f21a8b240500.png

1. Click the  button and log in with your Steam ID

2. Fill in the transfer token number that AeriaGames(Gamigo) gave

3. Write down Callsign(Nickname) you want

4. Click the  button

※ Please be aware if you make an account on steam before you submit the transfer request form, you will lose your account.


This message will pop up 

1. When the Callsign you put already has been taken

2. If your Steam account already has a linked game account

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/75ce6bb89c7c325e4f691a5a7fa8721e552b50f1.png


This message will pop up

1. When your transfer form has successfully been submitted

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/607edb0ee83c4d845ea86d9cddac4a0160e82af6.png


This message will pop up

1. When your transfer has been failed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/5f666bc26ef35420488d6d16f873c3d4bec669bc.png


If you have any problems after transferring your game account, please send an email to us: cs@neosonyx.com

The email should include the following:
- your Steam ID
You can find your Steam ID on the [Steam] main page > Click your profile above the page > Click Account details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223036/97306b9b7423c869510adba0c9010b641b6285e7.png


Thank you again for your love and interest in our game!
